name: Olives (Black)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they contain minimal fermentable carbohydrates. Watch sodium content if fluid retention is a concern.
preparationTips: Rinse canned olives to reduce sodium content
Choose olives without garlic or onion seasonings
Fresh olives from the deli counter often have fewer additives
Slice or chop to distribute flavor throughout dishes
